lines: Our instruments are picking up TWO overlapping signals from the bomber!
One wave won't be enough to jam it. We need to match both signals!
Use the PLUS button to add a second wave!
Now carefully adjust the knobs until BOTH waves match the enemy signal!
It's directly over us, we are doomed...
That was a composite signal. Some enemies combine multiple frequencies to make themselves harder to jam.
Remember: you can use multiple waves to match even the most complicated signals.
